The words of a poll, a case for each: a text written with the word any
old way, that text as it is laid out, the word written wrongly, and where
and why the reader refuses that. `WRITE_WORDS=1` on the test that reads
this writes what is laid out and what is refused, to be read before it is
kept.

=== poll.do
--- written
blueprint: w
on:
    poke:
        poll:
            every: 1m
            do: noop
        do: noop
--- laid
blueprint: w

on:
  poke:
    poll:
      every: 1m
      do: noop
    do: noop
--- wrong
blueprint: w
on:
    poke:
        poll:
            every: 1m
            do: nothing.like.it
        do: noop
--- refused 3:5
there is no action called `nothing.like.it`

=== poll.every
--- written
blueprint: w
on:
    poke:
        poll:
            every: 1m
            do: noop
        do: noop
--- laid
blueprint: w

on:
  poke:
    poll:
      every: 1m
      do: noop
    do: noop
--- wrong
blueprint: w
on:
    poke:
        poll:
            every: often
            do: noop
        do: noop
--- refused 4:9
`poll` needs `every: <duration>` and `do: <action>`

=== poll.with
--- written
blueprint: w
on:
    poke:
        poll:
            every: 1m
            do: log
            with: {message: hi}
        do: noop
--- laid
blueprint: w

on:
  poke:
    poll:
      every: 1m
      do: log
      with: { message: hi }
    do: noop
--- wrong
blueprint: w
on:
    poke:
        poll:
            every: 1m
            do: noop
            with: [a]
        do: noop
--- refused 7:19
`with` must be a mapping, found a list
